The incident occurred on Friday night when the child fell into a newly dug borewell at Chak Samana village.  **Deputy Commissioner Aashika Jain**, **Punjab Minister Ravjot Singh**, and **AAP MP Raj Kumar Chabbewal** were present during the operation, which involved teams from the NDRF, SDRF, Punjab Police, fire brigade personnel, and local volunteers. The rescue team created a narrow tunnel to reach the child, who was stabilized after being pulled out of the borewell.  The child's family expressed gratitude to all those involved in the successful rescue.

recent_articles.title: Seven killed in Gaza on Nakba Day as Israel says it targets Hamas member | Israel-Palestine conflict News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Israel** carried out two air strikes on a residential building and a civilian vehicle in Gaza City, killing at least seven Palestinians, including three women and a child. **Benjamin Netanyahu** and **Israel Katz**, the Israeli Prime Minister and Defence Minister respectively, stated that they targeted Izz al-Din al-Haddad, the head of Hamas' armed wing, as he was "responsible for the murder, abduction, and injury of thousands of Israeli civilians and IDF soldiers".  The strikes occurred on Nakba Day, a day commemorating the displacement of Palestinians in 1948. **Hamas** has not commented on the attacks.

recent_articles.title: Israel says it has killed Hamas commander in Gaza air strike
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Israel** claims to have killed **Hamas** commander Izz ad-Din al-Haddad in an air strike on Gaza City, accusing him of being responsible for the October 7th massacre.  The strike targeted a residential building and sparked a fire, with rescue teams struggling to evacuate the wounded. **Hamas** has neither confirmed nor denied the claim, while Israel maintains its right to target Hamas members despite a ceasefire in place since October 10th. The Israeli government accuses **Hamas** of refusing to disarm and breaching the ceasefire agreement, while US-led peace efforts have stalled due to the ongoing Iran war.

recent_articles.title: Elgar case: NIA seeks cancellation of bail of activists Sudha Bharadwaj and Varavara Rao - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The National Investigation Agency (NIA)** has requested a special court to cancel the bail of lawyer-activist **Sudha Bharadwaj** and poet-activist **Varavara Rao**, alleging they violated their bail conditions by attending a gathering at the Mumbai Press Club on January 19. The NIA presented evidence, including CCTV footage and call data records, suggesting the meeting was intended to propagate the ideology of the CPI (Maoist) and discuss the "Urban Naxal" movement.  The court has asked both individuals to respond to the agency's plea.

recent_articles.title: Man hit by van in Birmingham after residents take down union flags put up by anti-migrant group | Birmingham | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Police** are investigating an incident in Birmingham where a man was run over by a van after a group of people took down union flags put up by the Raise the Colours campaign. The man, in his 30s, suffered a broken leg that required surgery and remains hospitalized. **Raise the Colours**, a group known for putting up thousands of union and Saint George flags across England, has been criticized for spreading anti-immigrant rhetoric.  **West Midlands police** are examining CCTV footage and social media to identify the full circumstances of the incident.

recent_articles.title: Joyride horse dies of highly contagious zoonotic disease disease in Chennai; Tamil Nadu goes into alert mode - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The ICAR–National Research Centre on Equines (NRCE)** confirmed that a horse used for joyrides in the city has died from glanders, a highly contagious bacterial disease affecting equines. **The Besant Memorial Animal Dispensary (BMAD)** alerted authorities after noticing the horse's weakened condition and sent samples to the NRCE for testing. The NRCE advised the Tamil Nadu Animal Husbandry Department to isolate and monitor all equines in the area, implement surveillance and testing protocols, and regulate inter-state movement of horses. **The Tamil Nadu Animal Welfare Board** has requested that samples be collected from all joyride horses.

recent_articles.title: Supreme Court closes plea of Goa Congress leader after his death from snakebite - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** closed the plea of deceased **Ketan Bhatikar**, a Congress candidate for the Ponda Assembly seat, challenging a Bombay High Court order cancelling the bypoll.  Bhatikar died from a snakebite on Thursday and his lawyer requested the court to leave the larger question of law open while closing the proceedings. The High Court had earlier canceled the bypoll citing violation of the Representation of the People Act as less than one year remained in the term of the Assembly.

recent_articles.title: US stocks today: Dow Jones crashes 500 points on mounting inflation worries - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **U.S.** stock indexes declined as a surge in **Treasury yields**, driven by concerns over long-term inflation and energy prices, made higher-risk equities less attractive.  The yield on 10-year **Treasury notes** reached its highest level since May 2025, prompting investors to seek safer investments. The meeting between **President Donald Trump** and **Chinese President Xi Jinping** yielded few tangible results, adding to market uncertainty. Incoming **Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh** faces the challenge of navigating a potential rate hike if the Iran conflict leads to persistent inflation.

recent_articles.title: Israel and Lebanon agree ceasefire extension, US says | Israel | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Israel** and **Lebanon** extended their ceasefire for 45 days after successful talks in Washington.  The agreement followed two productive days of negotiations, with further discussions scheduled from June 2-3. The truce was due to expire on Sunday, but the extension aims to advance lasting peace between the countries, including full recognition of sovereignty and territorial integrity along their shared border.
